title: Settings repository (key/value)
interface: class SettingsRepository(conn). get(key) -> str | None. set(key, value: str, updated_by: str) -> None (INSERT OR REPLACE into table settings with updated_at=now UTC ISO). delete(key) -> bool. all() -> dict[str, str]. version() -> int: an integer that changes whenever a setting changes — return the count of rows plus the max(rowid) (or use a dedicated '__version__' counter row incremented on every set/delete, excluded from all()). the repository receives a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and calls conn.commit() after every write

uses.schema: src/db.py: table settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT, updated_at TEXT, updated_by TEXT)
